# PDFLY — Full Site Description for AI Crawlers

## What is PDFLY?

PDFLY (https://pdfly.live) is a free, browser-based online PDF toolkit offering 16 tools for common document tasks. It was built around one principle: most people need a single quick PDF task done — merge two PDFs, convert a Word document, compress a file — and then want to leave. So PDFLY provides the fastest path from "I need X done" to "done," with zero friction.

### Key differentiators
- 100% free with no daily limits
- No account or sign-up required
- No watermarks on output files
- Privacy-first: files are processed securely and deleted automatically after processing
- Works on any device — desktop, tablet, or phone
- Maximum file size: 200 MB per file

## Tool list and descriptions

### Convert tools
- **Word to PDF** (https://pdfly.live/word-to-pdf) — Convert Microsoft Word (.docx) documents to PDF format with preserved formatting.
- **PDF to Word** (https://pdfly.live/pdf-to-word) — Convert PDF files to editable Word (.docx) documents while preserving layout.
- **Excel to PDF** (https://pdfly.live/excel-to-pdf) — Convert Excel (.xlsx) spreadsheets to PDF.
- **Image to PDF** (https://pdfly.live/image-to-pdf) — Combine one or more images (JPG, PNG, WebP, etc.) into a single PDF.
- **PDF to Image** (https://pdfly.live/pdf-to-image) — Export each page of a PDF as a PNG image.

### Edit tools
- **Merge PDF** (https://pdfly.live/merge-pdf) — Combine multiple PDF files into a single document in any order.
- **Split PDF** (https://pdfly.live/split-pdf) — Split a PDF into individual pages or extract specific page ranges.
- **Compress PDF** (https://pdfly.live/compress-pdf) — Reduce PDF file size while maintaining quality.
- **Rotate PDF** (https://pdfly.live/rotate-pdf) — Rotate individual pages or the entire PDF document.
- **Reorder Pages** (https://pdfly.live/reorder-pages) — Rearrange the page order of a PDF with drag-and-drop.

### Security tools
- **Lock PDF** (https://pdfly.live/lock-pdf) — Add a password to a PDF using AES-256 encryption.
- **Unlock PDF** (https://pdfly.live/unlock-pdf) — Remove password protection from a PDF (when you know the password).

### Other tools
- **Add Watermark** (https://pdfly.live/add-watermark) — Add text or image watermarks to a PDF.
- **Add Page Numbers** (https://pdfly.live/add-page-numbers) — Add page numbers to a PDF document.
- **Extract Images** (https://pdfly.live/extract-images) — Extract all images embedded in a PDF.
- **QR Code Generator** (https://pdfly.live/qr-code-pdf) — Generate QR codes and save them as a PDF.
